component.name: CodexBar
component.summary: Agent usage limits for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: A panel applet for the COSMIC™ desktop that shows how much of your AI coding agent usage limits you have left, in the spirit of the macOS app CodexBar. This is a third-party applet, not official COSMIC software.

Clicking the panel icon opens a popup with a tab per provider, plus an Overview tab that summarizes every provider. Providers with several accounts list each account as a row you can expand. A provider's tab shows session, weekly and monthly usage as a percentage and a progress bar, when each limit window resets, the pace projection, today's and the last 30 days' cost and token counts, redeemable limit-reset credit, and remaining credits where the provider reports them. State refreshes every 60 seconds and whenever the popup is opened.

The applet does not talk to any provider itself. It shells out to the codexbar command-line tool from CodexBar, which must be installed separately on the host, and renders whatever that reports - so every provider CodexBar supports works here too, including Codex, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Cursor.

The Overview tab, condensing every provider's windows to one line each

ul.li: Multiple accounts for one provider appear as rows you can expand, with a small bar for each account's most-used limit.
Accounts can be given names with the account_labels setting.
Progress bars span the full popup width, and window names sit beside their percentages.
The scrollbar no longer covers text on the right edge.
Long emails are shortened instead of overlapping other text.
Provider service incidents, detail rows and unavailable quotas are shown.
Refreshes no longer overlap, and slow CLI calls time out.
Provider icons are synced with CodexBar.
